enhancement_focus: Smart Hyperlinks, Screenshot Placeholders, Error Documentation, Glossary Extraction
description: Test cases for Iteration 2 enhancements with focus on hyperlink generation, screenshot support, error codes, and automatic glossary

evals.prompt: Generate a Concept topic for 'Advanced Search with AI-Powered Filters' from the PRD. NEW: Auto-extract and include a glossary section listing technical terms used in the documentation (e.g., semantic search, relevance, personalization, faceted navigation). Add hyperlinks in the Related Topics section linking to other documentation pages.
evals.expected_output: HTML Concept topic with: proper structure, all required sections, a new Glossary section with 5+ technical terms and their definitions, and Related Topics section with actual hyperlinks (not plain text) pointing to /docs/setup.html, /docs/api-ref.html, /docs/best-practices.html

assertions.text: Glossary section is present with technical terms extracted and defined
At least 5 technical terms included with clear, concise definitions
Related Topics section contains actual hyperlinks (HTML <a> tags) with href attributes
Links point to standard documentation paths (/docs/ URLs)

evals.prompt: Generate a Reference topic for the Advanced Search API. NEW: Include a 'Common Error Responses' section documenting HTTP error codes (400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500, 503) with status messages and example error response JSON. Include hyperlinks in the Related Topics section.
evals.expected_output: HTML Reference topic with: parameter documentation tables (unchanged from iteration 1), a NEW 'Common Error Responses' section with table showing HTTP codes, status, description, and example JSON responses. Related Topics with functional hyperlinks.

assertions.text: Common Error Responses section is present in the reference documentation
All major HTTP error codes documented: 400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500, 503
Example JSON error responses provided for each error code
Errors presented in well-formatted table with columns: Code, Status, Description, Example
Related Topics section includes functional hyperlinks to related documentation

evals.prompt: Generate a Task topic for 'Setting Up Advanced Search'. NEW: The guide should include screenshot placeholders for UI interaction steps. Whenever a step mentions clicking a button, navigating menus, selecting options, or interacting with UI elements, insert a screenshot placeholder with: (1) a visual placeholder area, (2) a caption describing what to screenshot, (3) alt text for accessibility. Include hyperlinks in Related Topics.
evals.expected_output: HTML Task topic with: all required task sections (overview, prerequisites, numbered steps, verification), PLUS screenshot placeholders inserted at UI-interaction steps with visual indicator boxes showing '📸 Screenshot Placeholder' and descriptive captions. Each placeholder should indicate the step number and what UI element to capture. Related Topics with hyperlinks.

assertions.text: Screenshot placeholders inserted for UI-heavy steps
At least 5 screenshot placeholders included for major UI steps
Placeholders are visually distinct with blue dashed border, emoji indicator, and clear labeling
Each placeholder has descriptive caption indicating the step and what UI element to capture
Placeholders include alt text or accessibility descriptions
Related Topics section includes functional hyperlinks
